notes.title: [Fixed update] Fixed window size issue and added game end button
notes.notes:
Regarding Miko in Maguma, we have updated the following points.

2024/04/27　2:45

-Fixed a bug where the window size was too large
(The initial window size is now set to 1280 x 720.)

- Added window size change function
(Added the ability to change the window size using the Settings button → Screen.)

・Fixed full screen switching button
(Full screen switching has been changed from button format to check box format.)

-Added game end (app close button) to title

These are the points that have been corrected.

Regarding the window size correction, there was an issue where the game could not be played due to the window size before the correction.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
Thank you for reporting this matter through your inquiries and posts regarding the above.
Thanks to your report, we were able to make a faster fix.

Since it reflects the updated data,
I think updates will start sequentially.
If the update does not start, please check the documentation below.
https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/71AB-698D-57EB-178C

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: [Miko in Maguma] Release!!
notes.notes:
Miko in Maguma was officially released today!

Miko in Maguma has been officially ported to the Steam version from other platforms.

We have added the following elements from the other platform versions so that those who played on other platforms can also enjoy the game.

・Stage expansion
・Partial correction of images
・Addition of characters
・Addition of mini games
・Addition of how to play and rules explanation
・Supports Japanese, English, and Indonesian

Regarding other platforms, distribution has ended with the release of the Steam version.
For those of you who have played on other platforms, thank you very much for playing with us so far.
With the transition to the Steam version, we have added the above elements, so we would appreciate it if you could play again.

We hope that those who are playing this title for the first time, and those who continue to play it from other platforms, will enjoy it.

Thank you.
